authorInspection.limits: Author inspection, not independent review. Complete member families were read in three bounded, nontruncated ranges, including all spelling/reading/sense flags. No full comparison packet or comprehensive quiz/font audit is claimed.

readingObservations.allocationEvidence: Actual Digital Daijisen character heading コウ lists both 功績 and 成功. Whole-word identities and complete selected senses match JMdict1275070 and1375690. Existing articles explicitly give コウ+セキ and セイ+コウ; navigation is not the independent proof.
readingObservations.usefulness: Two useful existing achievement/success compounds suffice without adding duplicate lexical identities or inferring N1 vocabulary levels.
readingObservations.qualification: 功 includes achievement, merit, and successful accomplishment; it is not every neutral result, every effort, or a money contribution. Final learner-facing wording and quiz comparisons remain pending.

readingObservations.example: 功徳 くどく — merit; virtuous deed; blessing, in religious senses
readingObservations.allocationEvidence: Digital Daijisen character heading explicitly places 功徳くどく and 功力くりき under ク. Full JMdict1275080 retains Buddhism for its first two senses and Christianity for its third; it is not an unrestricted secular achievement synonym.
readingObservations.qualification: Valid recognized on reading, not an erroneous or universally archaic reading. A Buddhist-field label is not a frequency measurement. 功夫くふう belongs to the 工夫 family with a rare-kanji-spelling flag; separate 功夫カンフー/クンフー is a Chinese loanword family2014940, not evidence that the kanji's Japanese reading is カン.
readingObservations.remainingDecision: Prefer recognition-only treatment rather than adding a specialist support article solely to select this reading. Source completion must explicitly settle usefulness and the final row; unselected does not mean invalid.

readingObservations.example: 功 いさお — achievement; meritorious deed, dated
readingObservations.allocationEvidence: Full JMdict2411570 gives spellings 勲/功 and readingいさお with a dated-term flag. Digital Daijisen character heading lists訓いさお, and Seisenban Nihon Kokugo Daijiten has an actualいさおいさを【功・勲・績】heading. Jitsu likewise listsいさお.
readingObservations.qualification: This is a documented lexical kun reading, not merely an inferred personal name. Source nanori remain outside teaching scope. Separate功しいさおし family2870785 is usually-kana/obsolete/poetical in the noun sense and has distinct archaic adjective senses; it must not be silently substituted for rawいさお.
readingObservations.remainingDecision: Proposed lookup-only dated native noun, no selected question or new article solely for this form. Preserve the exact full metadata token and order.

fullFamilyRestrictionNotes: 1275180くのう is restricted to功能 and flagged obsolete-kana usage; it does not license assigning that reading to効能.
1560230労り/功り/功いたわり restricts the sympathy/care and illness senses to労り. The archaic service/meritorious-deed sense is not an everyday功いたわり teaching example.
1341260竣功 is a rare kanji spelling, whileしゅん功 is search-only. Preserve the different flag types and do not infer rare pronunciation from rare spelling.
1675030功力こうりき and1872670功力くりき are distinct complete families; the latter supports theク candidate. Do not equate identical spelling with a single primary reading.
2411570datedいさお and2411590こう are distinct lexical identities despite identical功 spelling.
1976500怪我の功名/ケガの功名 and2773720成功の鍵/成功のカギ retain reading-to-spelling restrictions; kana sequences inside longer words are not independent per-kanji allocation evidence.
Proper organization/work names at the end of the packet remain source evidence, not necessary support or a claim to have authored names.
